clips.title: The story
paras: In Thelsamar, Stoutlager Inn gives travelers a warm hearth and a place to gather in western Loch Modan.

Stoutlager Inn anchors community life in western Loch Modan, within Thelsamar. Miners, mountaineers, and travelers between Dun Morogh and the Wetlands stop to trade rumors, find lodging, and share dwarven ale. Troggs and kobolds make the wilderness beyond Thelsamar more dangerous, while the inn’s stone walls and fires offer shelter.
